title: factorization
description: A decomposition of a morphism through an intermediate: f : A → C factors through B when f = h ∘ g for g : A → B and h : B → C, drawn as a commuting triangle. The converse of composition; reveals a necessary waypoint when every path passes through it.

morphism.description: the morphism f : A → C being factored

intermediate.description: the waypoint object B the process must pass through

factors.description: f = h ∘ g with g : A → B and h : B → C
